text: DATA MANAGEMENT PLAN

label: content
text: The P.I. has completed human subjects training. The research assistants will be required to

label: subsection
text: complete human subjects training through the UCR Office of Research and Economic

label: content
text: Development.

label: content
text: The project will be submitted to the campus Institutional Review Board and requested revisions

label: content
text: to the project based on feedback from the IRB will be incorporated prior to data collection.

label: content
text: The researchers will ask all respondents to sign informed consent forms prior to interviews, as

label: content
text: well as in connection with the collection of survey data. These consent forms will include

label: content
text: information about how confidentiality of responses will be protected.

label: content
text: The longevity analysis will collect data on the length of time clusters have operated (including

label: content
text: the length of time between first hires and closures for those that have disbanded). We will

label: content
text: collect data from a minimum of 36 institutions, attempting to find dates of operation for all

label: content
text: clusters authorized at those institutions. The total number of clusters cannot be estimated at this

label: content
text: time but is likely to encompass as many as 150-200.

label: content
text: The comparative analysis will collect data on performance and attitudes from cluster

label: subsection
text: participants. The performance data will include publications, citations, research grants, patents,

label: content
text: licenses, and start-ups founded by members of interdisciplinary cluster hires, as well as those of

label: content
text: a matched sample of faculty hired through normal departmental mechanisms. The survey data

label: content
text: will include responses to five-page surveys from members of the interdisciplinary clusters. The

label: subsection
text: P.I. will also collect interview data from cluster leads and university administrators.

label: content
text: Performance and survey responses will be collected from a minimum of 72 individuals affiliated

label: content
text: with interdisciplinary clusters (at least three individuals from four institutions each in six fields),

label: content
text: and a matched sample of at least 72 individuals hired through normal departmental channels.

label: content
text: Interview data will be collected from a minimum of 24 cluster leads and four administrators. If

label: content
text: fields are drawn from multiple institutions, the number of interviews with cluster leads will

label: content
text: reflect the number of institutions and the number of fields included in the sample. The number

label: content
text: of interviews with university administrators will reflect the number of institutions included in the

label: content
text: sample.

label: content
text: The members of the project team will spot check coding on a 10 percent sample of individuals

label: content
text: hired through cluster programs and a 10 percent sample of individual hired through normal

label: content
text: departmental procedures. If problems arise in the validation of coding, more extensive checks

label: content
text: will be conducted. Coders will be instructed on the requirements for producing high quality

label: content
text: data, including meticulousness, conscientiousness, asking questions where uncertainties exist,

label: content
text: and double checking work.

label: content
text: Data will be backed up on a weekly basis on a hard drive kept in a locked cabinet in the project

label: content
text: Performance and survey data will be coded into STATA data files, including numeric

label: subsection
text: institutional and cluster identifiers, for subsequent data analysis. Data collected from individual

label: content
text: and institutions will be stripped of institutional identifications and given a letter title

label: subsection
text: corresponding to the institution’s name. The University of California, Riverside, for example,

label: content
text: might be labelled “Institution A.” Interviews will be tape recorded for consultation during the

label: content
text: writing of papers and reports. To our knowledge, there will be little overlap between the data

label: content
text: collected for this project and data collected by other researchers.

label: content
text: All data will be coded and saved on password-protected computers in the project office. No data

label: content
text: will be removed from the project office during the period of the project. The only individuals

label: content
text: with access to the collected data will be the P.I. and research assistants.

label: content
text: New research assistants will be advised of the essential care that must be taken with data collected

label: content
text: for this project. Any research assistants found to be handling data in a careless way will be immediately removed

label: content
text: Data from the project will be preserved in data files stripped of individual and institutional

label: content
text: names. These data files will include a small number of variables that will allow researchers to

label: content
text: categorize the institutions.

label: content
text: Following the completion of the project, the data archive will be made available on the project website

label: content
text: to researchers who are interested in pursuing questions related to cluster hiring. The preservation format

label: content
text: will be platform-independent.

label: content
text: Following the end of the project, we will contact the Inter-University Consortium for Political and Social Research

label: content
text: (ICPSR) at the University of Michigan about archiving the data on a permanent basis.

label: content
text: We do not anticipate additional costs for preparing data and documentation for archiving.
